# volcano_function (Resource)

A deployed Volcano function. Code, handler, runtime, and variable scoping are set once at creation - the API has no way to redeploy new code in place, so changing any of them replaces the function.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcano_function" "api" {
  project_id = volcano_project.example.id
  name       = "my-api-function"
  runtime    = "nodejs24.x"
  source     = "${path.module}/dist/my-api-function.zip"
  is_public  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) DNS-safe name (lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens). Forces replacement if changed.
- `project_id` (String)
- `runtime` (String) e.g. nodejs24.x, python3.13, ruby3.4. See the volcano_function_runtimes data source for valid values. Forces replacement if changed.
- `source` (String) Path to a local zip or tar.gz archive containing the function's source code and dependency manifests. Forces replacement if changed.

### Optional

- `handler` (String) Exported function name to invoke. Defaults to "handler". Forces replacement if changed.
- `http_auth_mode` (String) volcano (default) or none. none is valid only for public HTTP-mode functions.
- `invocation_mode` (String) rpc (default, POST {payload}) or http (forwards HTTP request semantics).
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the function is reachable through public invocation ingress.
- `openapi_spec` (String) JSON-encoded OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 metadata, for an http-mode function.
- `variable_scope` (String) all (default; shared project variables only) or scoped (only variables listed in `variables`). Forces replacement if changed.
- `variables` (List of String) Project variable names this function requires, on top of ones detected in its source. Only used when variable_scope is scoped. Forces replacement if changed.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `deployed_regions` (List of String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `invoke_url` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import volcano_function.api <project-id>,<function-id>
```
